data.long_meaning: The name Saswati is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Saswat’, which means ‘eternal’, ‘everlasting’, ‘perpetual’ or ‘continuous’. The name Saswati is believed to bring good fortune, prosperity, and abundance in one's life.
